sentence: The whole demo script, steps 1 to 12, runs with the demo clock moved from the admin panel and no console error, and ends with Noura's ticket seen with no overdue event on it, a logged contact-confirmed crisis event for Rashid, and the Urdu row flagged 18 to 22 points below overall; at step 11, 28 days in, the funnel's re-measured stage is a figure (35) and the symptom-change tile shows numbers with either period filter
The positive-screen stage equals unclaimed unexpired invites plus parentless tickets plus crisis events, counted straight from the tables, and the tile shows its note
A funnel stage or equity group under 10 people shows as suppressed, with no number, bar, flag or rate
The admin panel shows the crisis numbers' last_verified date, moves the demo clock by its three steps, resets to the seed and the real clock, and the API refuses the ops role the same controls

The admin panel's crisis-number source notes are the rules config's English text, marked as English and read from the left, and on the Arabic page each carries an Arabic label saying it is English only, because no Arabic source for them exists; the English page carries no such label

At 390 px the ops dashboard does not scroll sideways and no card scrolls inside itself; the timeliness figures stay inside their card, one block per tier with each figure under its column's name; and a symptom-change mean and its unit share one line inside their block, in Arabic and English
The clinic queue counts days left from the demo clock, so overdue marks agree with the API

Every mock or sample surface that exists carries its label: the mock TAMM page, the unverified instrument wording, the sample directory and indicative insurance, the Malaffi-ready export, the sample labs of the context panel, the no-login clinic link's sample channel, and the dashboard's simulated data
The clinician and ops apps declare an icon that loads, and their sign-in and home pages log no console error
The ops dashboard has the Arabic and English toggle and runs right to left in Arabic

Every tile and section of the ops dashboard has an info button that opens by Enter, Space and touch, is announced as a collapsed or expanded button, closes on Escape and returns the focus, and shows its definition, numerator, denominator, period and suppression note in the page's language, right to left in Arabic, in a 44 px target and with no sideways scroll at 390 px

The symptom-change tile shows numbers on the dashboard's default view straight after a reset: the re-measured count and, for both instruments, ten or more counted tickets, the mean change and the share who improved, while the share who deteriorated reads Suppressed in both (only four people stand behind it) and, straight after the reset, ten or more are excluded; choosing another period leaves the tile as it was, the page asks the API for the last 90 days each time, and the tile and its info panel say so

The dashboard shows the mean change and the shares with reliable improvement and deterioration among re-measured tickets from the totals people shared and chose to count in anonymous statistics (the threshold itself counts as reliable; tickets without both totals, or whose person did not opt in, are counted as excluded and move no figure), and its adverse events log records an event from the screen, offers only the legal status moves with their times, lists by status and severity, and holds no free text
The ops dashboard holds the board's type, colours, radii, chart sizes and 44 px tap targets
The ops dashboard matches the committed snapshot

A ticket past its deadline goes overdue on the demo clock, the phone shows the overdue prompt, the prompt leads to a reroute that moves the old ticket to rerouted, and the ops dashboard's overdue list counts the tickets the table holds as overdue
After a reset from the admin panel, the same phone registers as the same person again, drops the ticket the server no longer holds without asking for it a second time, and keeps its check-in history
A person who opts in to the group totals on the phone adds one ticket to their age band's row on the ops dashboard, and no other row moves
A crisis screen shown on a phone, a number tapped and contact confirmed add one to the dashboard's screens shown, called a line and contact confirmed
